ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle with the height $AH=8\,\text{cm}$. $P$ is a moving point on $AH$, and $D$ is the midpoint of $AB$. What is the minimum value of $PD+PB$ in $\,\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle and $AH$ is the height,\\
$\therefore$ point $H$ is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
point $B$ is symmetric to point $C$ with respect to $AH$, connecting $DC$ intersects $AH$ at a point $P$, at this moment there is a minimum value, the minimum value is the length of $DC$,\\
since $D$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
$\therefore DC$ is the height from $AB$,\\
$\therefore DC=AH=8$,\\
$\therefore PD+PB=PD+PC=DC=\boxed{8\,\text{cm}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The accompanying figure is a geometric figure, with the outer outline being triangle ABC, A above, and B and C at the two ends of the base; a vertical altitude AH is drawn from A to the base BC, with H on BC. Point P is marked on AH and can move along AH; point D is marked on side AB, and the problem statement explains that D is the midpoint of AB. The figure also draws the line segments from B to P and from D to P. Reasoning: Because △ABC is an equilateral triangle, and AH is the altitude from vertex A to the base BC, AH is also the perpendicular bisector of BC, and B and C are symmetric with respect to the line AH. Since P is on AH, the distances from P to the symmetric points B and C are equal, that is, PB=PC. Therefore PD+PB=PD+PC. For any P, from the triangle inequality in the line-segment relationship, we can get PD+PC ≥ DC. Equality holds if and only if the three points D, P, C are collinear, and P is located at the intersection of DC and AH; this intersection is indeed on AH, so the minimum value is DC. Also because D is the midpoint of side AB of the equilateral triangle, the median CD from C to D is also the altitude to side AB. The three altitudes of an equilateral triangle are equal, so CD=AH=8 cm. Therefore the minimum value of PD+PB is 8 cm.
